Generated fixtures (numbers-100.xlsx, strings-100.xlsx, sheets-10x10.xlsx, features.xlsx,
features-1904.xlsx, truncated.xlsx, features-encrypted.xlsx) come from gen_fixtures.py in the
parent folder. features-encrypted.xlsx was encrypted with msoffcrypto-tool (password "spike-a");
Excel COM was installed but refused Workbooks.Open from this non-interactive session.
